claims.statement: The Ministry says covered entities conduct waste records and reporting electronically in BDO, while specified low-volume waste categories are exempt.

PGK Śrem's price list effective 16 March 2026 lists gross prices from 498 PLN to 3,591 PLN for mixed renovation and construction-waste container pickups, showing a concrete paid event in part of Wielkopolska; it is one provider and is not a national price benchmark.
Embedding compliant paperwork into the pickup transaction could be more monetizable than selling BDO form entry by itself.
The rate of rejected cards, miscoded waste and avoidable surcharges among small installation contractors is unknown.

contrary_evidence: BDO itself is a government system and small quantities of listed wastes are exempt.
Collectors or office staff may already prepare cards as part of the pickup relationship.
Automated code suggestions create environmental and financial liability if presented without human confirmation.

economics.acquisition_route: Start with the founder's family renewable installer as a design partner, then distribute through waste collectors, electrical and HVAC wholesalers, installer associations and field-service software vendors.
economics.founder_time: Part-time validation hypothesis; delivery burden remains untested.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Local data linking job type, waste code, photos, estimated versus measured weight, contamination surcharge, collector price and service reliability can improve quoting and reduce rejected or repriced pickups.
fingerprint.customer: Polish photovoltaic, heat-pump, electrical and renovation contractors that generate non-exempt waste away from the office, plus licensed collectors that want lower-friction contractor accounts.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Start with the founder's family renewable installer as a design partner, then distribute through waste collectors, electrical and HVAC wholesalers, installer associations and field-service software vendors.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: A mobile job-to-waste record system with photo capture, human-confirmed code suggestions, BDO-ready fields, collector quote and slot comparison, weight reconciliation and a complete project evidence pack. Monetize by contractor subscription plus a disclosed collector booking fee.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The contractor already pays at each container or waste pickup and would pay a small monthly workflow fee or booking take-rate; collectors could fund a white-label version to acquire compliant repeat customers. A 2026 Wielkopolska provider price list evidences paid pickups, but not national willingness to pay for software.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A job creates cable, packaging, insulation, demolition or equipment waste; before handoff the contractor must select the right waste code, create the electronic record or transfer card, estimate mass and coordinate a paid pickup whose price can change with contamination or weight.

founder_fit: Direct pilot access through the family renewable-energy company.
Combines mobile workflow automation, data quality and a marketplace without large initial capital.
Can expand from one contractor niche to other field-service trades.
risks: Evidence of a workflow, transition, or loss does not yet establish recurring willingness to pay.
The proposed distribution and compounding mechanisms remain hypotheses pending buyer evidence.

title: Mobile BDO and waste-pickup workflow for installation contractors
uncertainties: Which installer waste streams are consistently inside BDO rather than municipal or quantity exemptions?
Do collectors permit booking and status integrations, or would the first version require manual coordination?
Is the price spread or paperwork burden large enough to support a take-rate after customer support?
Pricing, buyer authority, and acquisition economics remain unvalidated at discovery.

First validation test: Instrument 30 real waste handoffs from the family installer and four unrelated contractors, recording staff time, corrections, measured-weight variance, surcharges and quote spread. Obtain two collector partners and charge for a ten-job white-label pilot only after proving faster compliant handoff or lower total pickup cost.
